Spanish-sage monoterpenoid preparation, with cognitive and mood outcomes in healthy adults. Carry route and endpoint differences into further review.
Aroma comparison across sage species, with memory and mood outcomes. Aromatic exposure differs from eating dried leaf.
Recovered PDF, Table 1 and Figures 3 and 4. The same dried-leaf dose shows opposite alertness directions across conditions, with no apathy measure.
Oral Spanish-sage essential oil, cognitive tasks and Bond-Lader mood in healthy volunteers. Distinct species/preparation and population.

Common and Spanish sage combination in mice, with learning in a water maze. Cognivia product context, separate from human apathy.
